title: Miboujin kaseifu: Nakadashi no yuuwaku
original_title: 未亡人家政婦 中出しの四十路
overview: After her husband's death, Michiko takes a live-in job as a housekeeper for a university professor named Igarashi. One day, while she is indulging in masturbation before her husband's mortuary tablet, the ghost of her late husband, Hiroaki, appears.
